sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: By selecting the consent checkbox when submitting a form on vazuri.io, I consent to the controller processing my personal data to handle my enquiry, contact me and prepare a proposal.

sections.title: 2. Data and processing
paragraphs: Consent covers my name, phone number, email or Telegram contact, selected service, enquiry content, request source and language, receipt date and time, and consent records.

I authorise collection, recording, organisation, accumulation, storage, updating, retrieval, use, provision of access, restriction, deletion and destruction, with and without automated means. Requests are processed using hosting and the Mail.ru email service.

sections.title: 3. Duration and withdrawal
paragraphs: Consent remains valid until the enquiry and correspondence are concluded or consent is withdrawn. Withdrawal should be sent to hello@vazuri.io or the following addresses: 34 Yablonevaya Alley, Kaliningrad, Russia; 71/1 Nevsky Prospekt, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 191023.
After the purpose is achieved or consent is withdrawn, data are destroyed within 30 days unless the law or another legal ground permits further processing.
Privacy policy: https://vazuri.io/en/privacy.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: Correspondence addresses: 34 Yablonevaya Alley, Kaliningrad, Russia; 71/1 Nevsky Prospekt, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 191023. Personal data are processed under Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 on Personal Data.

sections.title: 2. Data and purposes
paragraphs: The data processed include name, phone number, email or Telegram contact, selected service, enquiry content, request source and language, receipt date and time, and consent records. The purposes are handling enquiries, communicating with users and preparing proposals. The legal grounds are user consent, entering into and performing a contract.
Technical data (IP address, browser, page, request date and time) are processed to operate and protect the website on the basis of the controller’s legitimate interests, respecting users’ rights.
Essential cookies and browser storage retain website settings. Appearance cookies last up to one year; persistent settings remain until deleted, and temporary settings until the session ends.

sections.title: 3. Processing and recipients
paragraphs: Processing includes collection, recording, organisation, accumulation, storage, updating, retrieval, use, provision of access, restriction, deletion and destruction, with and without automated means.
Requests are delivered to the controller by email through Mail.ru. The website uses hosting, Tilda and Kinescope components; third-party components may process technical data and cookies.

sections.title: 4. Retention
paragraphs: Data are retained until the enquiry and correspondence are concluded or consent is withdrawn. After the purpose is achieved or consent is withdrawn, data are destroyed within 30 days unless the law or another legal ground permits further processing. Technical data are retained within the purposes of website operation and security.

sections.title: 5. Rights and data protection
paragraphs: Users may obtain information about processing, request correction, restriction or destruction, withdraw consent, and complain to Roskomnadzor or a court. Requests should be sent to hello@vazuri.io or the correspondence address.
Data are protected through HTTPS, access restrictions and measures against automated requests.
